post.title: Strategy Design Pattern: Simplifying Software Design
post.subtitle: Stop writing massive if-else statements. The Strategy Pattern allows you to swap algorithms at runtime. We explain it with a Payment Processing exampl
post.brief: The Strategy Pattern replaces giant `if-else` or `switch` blocks with a family of interchangeable algorithm classes. Each strategy is a self-contained unit that can be swapped at runtime without touching the client code. The result: Open/Closed Principle compliance and dramatically easier testing.
